newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: East Asia board agrees to form new unit.
newsitem.headline: East Asia board agrees to form new unit.

text.p: The Philippines' East Asia Power Resources Corp said on Monday its board of directors had approved the setting up of an investment and management subsidiary to handle the firm's electricity transmission and distribution activities.
In an advisory, East Asia said it would have 100 percent ownership of the proposed unit.
The board also approved an amendment to an earlier resolution of the board to sell new shares at a minimum price of 8.50 pesos apiece.
The board said East Asia will now be able to sell the shares at a price range of 7.20 to 11.50 pesos each. The statement did not say how many new shares will be sold.
East Asia is partly owned by Van der Horst Ltd of Singapore and Filinvest Development Corp of the Philippines.
